closed_entry:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import release
import re
text = open('src/gaps.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
entries = re.split(r'\n(?=\d+\. \*\*)', text)
third = next((e for e in entries if e.startswith('3. **')), '')
assert '\n    *2026-10-22, closed.* ' in third and '#70' in third, 'closed_entry: entry 3 was closed by #70 on 2026-10-22 and must gain, on its own line indented four spaces, the note *2026-10-22, closed.* followed by a sentence naming #70, the form entry 2 already uses; got entry 3 as %r' % third
assert third.startswith('3. **A flaky test is a timing patch.** Two tests patch time.sleep process-wide.\n'), 'closed_entry: the title and text of entry 3 must stay as they were; got %r' % third
assert re.findall(r'^(\d+)\. ', text, re.M) == ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5'], 'closed_entry: entries keep their numbers 1 to 5; got %r' % re.findall(r'^(\d+)\. ', text, re.M)
head_constant:

assert release.HEAD == '1f3e5d7', 'head_constant: release.HEAD must be the 7-character id of the last merge commit the chain made, 1f3e5d7; got %r' % release.HEAD
assert callable(release.note) and '1f3e5d7' in release.note(), 'head_constant: note() must still exist and name the head; got %r' % release.note()
head_line:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import release
text = open('src/status.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'Chain head: main at 1f3e5d7 (2026-10-22).' in text, 'head_line: the chain head line must read exactly Chain head: main at 1f3e5d7 (2026-10-22). (the 7-character id of the last merge the chain made, and the chain date); got %r' % [l for l in text.splitlines() if l.startswith('Chain head')]
assert 'e19c74b (2026-10-21)' not in text, 'head_line: the old chain head line must not remain'
landed_order:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import release
assert release.CHAIN == '2026-10-22', 'landed_order: release.CHAIN must be the date of the chain in the log, 2026-10-22; got %r' % release.CHAIN
assert release.LANDED == (70, 63, 65, 64), 'landed_order: release.LANDED must be the tuple of the pull request numbers the chain merged, as integers, in the order the chain merged them (70, 63, 65, 64); got %r' % (release.LANDED,)
narrowed_entry:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import release
import re
text = open('src/gaps.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
entries = re.split(r'\n(?=\d+\. \*\*)', text)
fourth = next((e for e in entries if e.startswith('4. **')), '')
assert '\n    *2026-10-22, closed in part.* ' in fourth and '#65' in fourth, 'narrowed_entry: entry 4 was narrowed, not closed, by #65 on 2026-10-22: it must gain, on its own line indented four spaces, the note *2026-10-22, closed in part.* followed by a sentence naming #65 (a narrowed entry is closed in part, in the dated italic form entry 2 uses); got entry 4 as %r' % fourth
assert fourth.startswith('4. **A credential reaches a check through the contract.** The contract names the variable and the value.\n'), 'narrowed_entry: the title and text of entry 4 must stay as they were; got %r' % fourth
fifth = next((e for e in entries if e.startswith('5. **')), '')
assert fifth.strip() == '5. **A fixture\'s difficulty is claimed against a model.** The stand-in cannot fail it by construction.', 'narrowed_entry: entry 5 was not touched by the chain (#66 did not land) and must stay exactly as it was; got %r' % fifth
table_rows:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import release
text = open('src/status.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
rows = [l for l in text.splitlines() if l.startswith('| #')]
expected = ['| #59 | syberlabs/5e3688b2 | superseded | - |', '| #61 | syberlabs/e19f606b | merged | e19c74b |', '| #70 | syberlabs/17f5d831 | merged | 5e1c9a0 |', '| #63 | syberlabs/d9a1cc66 | merged | 9b7d2e4 |', '| #65 | syberlabs/b2e9bf61 | merged | c3a5e7f |', '| #64 | syberlabs/afc19144 | merged | 1f3e5d7 |', '| #66 | syberlabs/522ca1aa | open | - |']
assert rows == expected, 'table_rows: the packets table must list the two earlier rows unchanged, then the four pull requests the chain merged as merged with the 7-character id of their merge commit, in the order the chain merged them (the log order, not the number order), then #66 still open; expected rows %r, got %r' % (expected, rows)
test_doc:
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); import release
import unittest, test_landing
doc = test_landing.__doc__ or ''
assert doc == 'The landing record of the chain of 2026-10-22: #63, #64, #65 and #70 merged, #66 not landed.', 'test_doc: the module docstring must read exactly: The landing record of the chain of 2026-10-22: #63, #64, #65 and #70 merged, #66 not landed. (the merged pull requests in ascending number order, then the one that did not land); got %r' % doc
src = open('src/test_landing.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
for phrase in ['len("#66"), 3', '"e19c74b"[:2], "e1"']:
    assert phrase in src, 'test_doc: %r is test data, not a record of the chain, and must stay; got %r' % (phrase, src)
assert unittest.main(module=test_landing, argv=['x'], exit=False).result.wasSuccessful(), 'test_doc: test_landing must still pass'
